# Test Fixtures

Small public fixtures may live here. Private Bedrock worlds do not belong in this directory.

Explicitly allowed is the generated, non-playable scanner fixture `public_scanner_world.zip`. Private worlds belong under `fixtures/private/`; that folder is ignored locally and excluded from releases.

The fixture workflow is described in [docs/development.md](../../docs/development.md) under "Test fixtures and private worlds". The security and privacy reasons are in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
